listing.name: Plasma Burn Escape
listing.summary: This mod gives these three ships the ability to escape with Plasma Burn, and changes their approach angle accordingly, so that escaping later is easier.
listing.aiSummary: Adds Plasma Burn escape capabilities to the Shrike, Fury, and Odyssey ships.

description:
Plasma Burn Escape
Plasma Burn escapes for the Shrike, Fury and Odyssey.

Download

Plasma Burn Escape v0.1.1 (OneDrive). Source code is in the same zip, in the src folder.

Requirements

Starsector 0.98a-RC8
Install: extract the zip into your Starsector/mods folder, then enable the mod in the launcher.
No dependencies. Nothing else is needed.

Save compatibility
Safe to add to an existing campaign, and safe to remove mid-campaign.

What it does

This mod gives these three ships the ability to escape with Plasma Burn, and changes their approach angle accordingly, so that escaping later is easier.

Screenshots

Notes

The mod wraps internal vanilla AI classes, so it is version-locked. Expect breakage on game versions other than the one listed.
Behaviour is hand-tuned and may still be rough in unusual fleet compositions.

Credits and permissions
Made by cheny. You may use it in mod packs, videos and streams with credit. Please do not redistribute modified versions or reupload it without permission.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: ChatGPT 6 Luna, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017

No other assets: the mod contains no sprites, portraits, ships or audio of its own, and it does not modify vanilla assets. No additional training data was used, and no fine-tuning was done; the code was written in AI-assisted sessions, then adjusted and tested in game by the author.

Changelog

0.1.1
Added: the three ships now adjust their approach angle according to their own hard flux level.
Fixed: escape is now judged on hard flux instead of total flux.

0.1.0 - First release.
